title: Generate-then-Rank: Learning Symbolic Goal Interpretation for Embodied Agents
title_zh: 生成后排序：面向具身智能体的符号化目标解读学习

paragraphs.en: Goal interpretation is to translate a natural language instruction into a formal symbolic goal that a planner can execute. It is critical for embodied agents because any error here propagates to every downstream planning and action step. Doing it well requires both generating suitable candidates and reliably selecting among them. We present a two-stage generate-then-rank approach to Goal Interpretation in the Embodied Agent Interface (EAI). First, supervised fine-tuning adapts a Large Language Model (LLM) to EAI’s output convention. Second, Candidate-Output Ranking from Errors (CORE) learns preferences over complete outputs from the model’s own generated alternatives. We conducted experiments on the household scenes of the Embodied Agent Interface Benchmark. Multiple open source LLMs including DeepSeek-V3 chat, DeepSeek-Reasoner, and Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen2.5-72B were evaluated. The proposed method outperformed the baseline models including LLMs with simple prompting, chain-of-thought, and knowledge graph based approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 目标解读是将自然语言指令转换为规划器可执行的形式化符号目标。 它对具身智能体至关重要，因为此处的任何错误都会传播到后续所有规划与行动步骤。 做好这一任务既需要生成合适的候选目标，也需要在其中可靠地进行选择。 我们提出了一种面向具身智能体接口（EAI）中目标解读的两阶段“生成再排序”方法。 首先，通过监督微调使大语言模型（LLM）适应 EAI 的输出约定。 其次，基于错误的候选输出排序（CORE）从模型自身生成的备选输出中学习对完整输出的偏好。 我们在具身智能体接口基准的家庭场景上进行了实验。 评估了多个开源大语言模型，包括 DeepSeek-V3 chat、DeepSeek-Reasoner、Qwen2.5-7B 和 Qwen2.5-72B。 所提出的方法优于基线模型，包括采用简单提示、思维链以及基于知识图谱方法的大语言模型。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly connect natural-language instructions to embodied planning and action [ 1 , 12 , 16 ] . Before planning, however, an agent must determine what terminal conditions constitute success. Goal interpretation is to translate a natural language instruction into a formal symbolic goal that a planner can execute. It is critical for embodied agents because any error here propagates to every downstream planning and action step. The Benchmark Embodied Agent Interface (EAI) [ 5 ] formalises this goal interpretation task as a mapping from a VirtualHome scene and instruction to object states, directed relations, and terminal actions [ 5 , 7 ] . An omitted condition, unintended relation, or incompatible predicate argument can make downstream behaviour incomplete or infeasible even when the planner is otherwise correct.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地将自然语言指令与具身规划和动作连接起来 [ 1 , 12 , 16 ] 。 然而，在规划之前，智能体必须确定哪些终止条件构成成功。 目标解释是指将自然语言指令翻译成规划器可以执行的正式符号目标。 这对具身智能体至关重要，因为此处的任何错误都会传播到每一个下游的规划和动作步骤。 具身智能体接口基准（EAI）[ 5 ] 将这一目标解释任务形式化为从 VirtualHome 场景和指令到对象状态、有向关系和终止动作的映射 [ 5 , 7 ] 。 一个遗漏的条件、无意图的关系或不兼容的谓词参数，即使规划器在其他方面是正确的，也可能使下游行为不完整或不可行。

paragraphs.en: For example, the instruction “wash dishes with dishwasher” in Fig. 1 requires the dishwasher to be CLOSED and ON and the directed relations ON(plate, dishwasher) , ON(cup, dishwasher) , and ON(dish_soap, dishwasher) . Walking to the kitchen or opening the dishwasher is an intermediate step, not a terminal goal. A goal that omits ON(dish_soap, dishwasher) is still well formed, yet it is incomplete. A relation is also directed: ON(plate, dishwasher) is correct, whereas ON(dishwasher, plate) is wrong. Well-formed output alone therefore does not ensure correct goal interpretation.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，图 1 中的指令“用洗碗机洗碗”要求洗碗机处于 CLOSED 和 ON 状态，并且存在有向关系 ON(plate, dishwasher)、ON(cup, dishwasher) 和 ON(dish_soap, dishwasher)。 走到厨房或打开洗碗机只是中间步骤，而不是最终目标。 一个省略了 ON(dish_soap, dishwasher) 的目标在格式上仍然有效，但却是完整的吗？不，它是不完整的。 关系也是有方向的：ON(plate, dishwasher) 是正确的，而 ON(dishwasher, plate) 则是错误的。 因此，仅仅输出格式有效并不能确保目标被正确解释。

paragraphs.en: Direct generation provides a useful baseline [ 5 ] , but the single output a model returns is not necessarily the best goal it can generate: sampling several outputs can yield a more complete goal. Task-specific supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can adapt an LLM to the required output format and sparse terminal-goal convention [ 8 , 4 ] . SFT alone, however, optimises reference-token likelihood rather than an explicit preference between complete candidate goals. Sequence-level ranking has addressed related mismatches in text generation [ 6 , 17 ] . Our candidate analysis motivates studying this mismatch for symbolic goal interpretation: a better goal may already be generated but remain unselected.
paragraphs.zh: 直接生成提供了一个有用的基线 [ 5 ] ，但模型返回的单一输出未必是它所能生成的最佳目标：采样多个输出可以得到更完整的目标。 针对特定任务的监督微调（SFT）可以让大语言模型适应所需的输出格式和稀疏的终局目标约定 [ 8 , 4 ] 。 然而，仅靠 SFT 优化的是参考词元的似然，而非完整候选目标之间的显式偏好。 序列级排序已在文本生成中解决了相关的不匹配问题 [ 6 , 17 ] 。 我们对候选的分析促使我们研究符号目标解释中的这种不匹配：更好的目标可能已被生成，却未被选中。

paragraphs.en: Our approach comprises two learned stages, shown in Fig. 1 . Stage 1 is supervised fine-tuning for goal generation: it takes the scene and instruction and produces several complete candidate goals. Stage 2 is learning to rank candidate outputs, which we call Candidate-Output Ranking from Errors (CORE): it takes the input and its candidate pool, assigns every candidate a sequence score, and outputs the highest-scoring goal. CORE is learned rather than rule-based. During training it compares the model’s own better and worse candidates and adjusts the scorer so that higher-quality complete Node–Edge–Action outputs receive higher scores, while a supervised anchor retains the reference target. Its contribution is the application of error-derived candidate ranking to symbolic goals, rather than a claim to invent supervised or preference learning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法包含两个经学习的阶段，如图1所示。 阶段1是用于目标生成的监督微调：它接收场景和指令，并生成若干个完整的候选目标。 阶段2是学习对候选输出进行排序，我们称之为基于错误的候选输出排序（CORE）：它接收输入及其候选池，为每个候选分配一个序列得分，并输出得分最高的目标。 CORE 是通过学习得到的，而非基于规则的。 在训练过程中，它比较模型自身生成的较好和较差的候选，并调整评分器，使得质量更高的完整「节点–边–动作」输出获得更高的分数，同时由一个监督锚点保留参考目标。 其贡献在于将基于错误导出的候选排序应用于符号化目标，而非声称发明了监督学习或偏好学习。

paragraphs.en: Our main contributions are as follows: (i) a two-stage generate-then-rank approach that combines generation and ranking to improve goal interpretation with large language models; (ii) a training procedure that first applies supervised fine-tuning and then learns to rank candidates from the model’s own errors with a contrastive objective; and (iii) experiments on the household scenes of the Embodied Agent Interface benchmark, comparing several LLMs and baselines that include supervised fine-tuning, candidate-level preference optimisation, and knowledge-graph-based methods.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下：(i) 一种两阶段的「生成后排序」方法，结合生成与排序，以改进基于大语言模型的目标理解；(ii) 一种训练流程，先应用监督微调，然后通过对比目标从模型自身的错误中学习对候选进行排序；(iii) 在 Embodied Agent Interface 基准的家庭场景上进行实验，比较了多种大语言模型和基线方法，包括监督微调、候选级偏好优化以及基于知识图谱的方法。

paragraphs.en: Embodied-language systems ground instructions in affordances, generate action programs, and interleave reasoning with interaction [ 1 , 12 , 16 ] . EAI instead isolates four interfaces: goal interpretation, subgoal decomposition, action sequencing, and transition modelling [ 5 ] . Goal interpretation predicts sparse terminal Node, Edge, and Action records rather than a trajectory. This distinction makes plausible intermediate actions false positives and requires exact relation direction, cardinality, and stopping.
paragraphs.zh: 具身语言系统将指令锚定在可供性上，生成动作程序，并将推理与交互交错进行 [1, 12, 16]。 EAI 则隔离出四个接口：目标解读、子目标分解、动作排序以及状态转移建模 [5]。 目标解读预测的是稀疏的终止 Node、Edge 和 Action 记录，而非一条轨迹。 这一区分使得看似合理的中间动作成为误报，并要求关系方向、基数和停止条件完全精确。

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive likelihood scores token sequences, whereas EAI evaluates the parsed final set. Candidate-ranking methods such as BRIO and SLiC-HF calibrate complete outputs with preference and supervised signals [ 6 , 17 ] ; DPO learns preferences relative to a frozen reference policy [ 9 ] . Cal-DPO additionally calibrates implicit reward magnitudes [ 14 ] ; CORE instead uses reference-derived quality gaps to scale pairwise margins. CORE applies this sequence-level perspective to complete symbolic goals, using realised model errors and an SFT anchor. Related planning research also shows the value of structured environmental evidence [ 10 , 15 ] ; we therefore include knowledge-graph-based comparators in our experiments. EAI itself evaluates LLMs by direct generation [ 5 ] ; ranking among complete candidate goals is not part of that protocol, which is the gap our second stage addresses.
paragraphs.zh: 自回归似然对词元序列进行打分，而 EAI 评估解析后的最终集合。 BRIO 和 SLiC-HF 等候选排序方法利用偏好信号和监督信号对完整输出进行校准 [ 6 , 17 ] ；DPO 相对于冻结的参考策略学习偏好 [ 9 ] 。 Cal-DPO 额外对隐式奖励幅度进行校准 [ 14 ] ；CORE 则使用由参考派生的质量差距来缩放成对间隔。 CORE 将这种序列级视角应用于完整的符号目标，利用实际模型误差和 SFT 锚点。 相关规划研究也显示了结构化环境证据的价值 [ 10 , 15 ] ；因此我们在实验中纳入了基于知识图谱的对比方法。 EAI 本身通过直接生成来评估大语言模型 [ 5 ] ；在完整候选目标之间进行排序并不属于该协议的范围，这正是我们第二阶段所解决的空白。

paragraphs.en: Sampling and self-consistency offer another way to use multiple model outputs [ 13 ] ; our selector instead scores deduplicated, complete symbolic candidates. Constrained decoding, exemplified by PICARD, checks admissibility during generation [ 11 ] . DOMINO aligns formal constraints with subword tokenisation [ 2 ] . Neither Cal-DPO nor these decoding methods is reproduced here.

paragraphs.en: Greedy decoding takes the most probable token at every step. Each choice is locally best, but the resulting complete goal is not necessarily the best goal the model can produce: one early token, such as the source of an Edge, fixes the rest of the output. Sampling several complete outputs exposes alternatives, and our candidate analysis (Section 5 ) finds items whose pool contains a better goal than the one selected. Stage 1, however, is trained only to reproduce reference tokens; nothing teaches it to score a better complete candidate above a worse one. Stage 2 therefore adds a learning-to-rank step. Unlike a fixed scoring rule, its ranking function is optimised from data.
paragraphs.zh: 贪心解码在每一步都选取概率最高的词元。 每次选择都是局部最优的，但由此得到的完整目标未必是模型能产出的最佳目标：一个早期词元（例如某条 Edge 的来源）就固定了后续的全部输出。 采样多个完整输出能暴露出多种备选方案，我们的候选分析（第 5 节）会发现某些条目的候选池中存在优于所选目标的目标。 然而，阶段 1 仅被训练用于复现参考词元；没有任何机制教它把更优的完整候选排在更差的候选之上。 因此，阶段 2 增加了一个学习排序的步骤。 与固定的评分规则不同，其排序函数是从数据中优化得到的。

paragraphs.en: The study uses the 342 public Goal Interpretation records from EAI [ 5 ] , whose household scenes derive from VirtualHome [ 7 ] . Each record contains an instruction, the relevant scene and schema, and a sparse reference goal with Node states, directed Edge relations, and terminal Actions. The target represents success conditions, not an action sequence. Prompts and reference semantics are retained unchanged; identifier, parsing, duplication, and split-conservation checks verify the materialised corpus.
paragraphs.zh: 该研究使用 EAI [5] 的 342 条公开目标解读记录，其家庭场景来自 VirtualHome [7]。 每条记录包含一条指令、相关场景与模式（schema），以及一个稀疏的参考目标，其中包含节点（Node）状态、有向边（Edge）关系和终止动作（Action）。 目标表示的是成功条件，而非动作序列。 提示词与参考语义保持不变；通过标识符、解析、重复以及划分保持性检查来验证实体化后的语料库。

paragraphs.en: We include two distinct knowledge-based routes. The unadapted Qwen2.5–7B KG-prompt arm prepends scene-relevant schema hints (object states, relation constraints and implications) to the task prompt, without SFT or CORE. We score its archived raw response, without the older pipeline’s deductive closure or refinement, to isolate this prompt-only configuration. The Euclidean and hyperbolic KG arms instead combine standard SFT with projected KG prefix representations, without CORE ranking. Their archived runs use the same 274/68 task split, three epochs, learning rate 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} and seed 42. They are KG-enhanced language models, not standalone symbolic KG solvers. We re-evaluate all archived outputs on the same 68 identifiers using the current original-EAI resources; re-evaluation reproduces the SFT baseline. These are configuration comparisons with differing training and inference procedures, not isolated causal estimates of KG utility.
paragraphs.zh: 我们纳入两条不同的基于知识的路线。 未适配的 Qwen2.5–7B KG 提示分支会在任务提示前加入与场景相关的模式提示（对象状态、关系约束及其含义），但不进行 SFT 或 CORE。 我们对其存档的原始回复进行评分，不采用旧流程的演绎闭包或精炼步骤，以隔离这种仅用提示的配置。 欧氏与双曲 KG 分支则将标准 SFT 与投影后的 KG 前缀表示相结合，但不使用 CORE 排序。 它们的存档运行使用相同的 274/68 任务划分、三个轮次、学习率 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} 以及随机种子 42。 它们是 KG 增强的语言模型，而非独立的符号 KG 求解器。 我们使用当前的原版 EAI 资源，在相同的 68 个标识符上重新评估所有存档输出；重新评估复现了 SFT 基线。 这些是训练与推理流程各不相同的配置比较，而非对 KG 效用的孤立因果估计。

paragraphs.en: The validated preference-learning arm uses model-generated, candidate-level pairs but optimises Direct Preference Optimisation (DPO) [ 9 ] . It also trains on positive–negative pairs ( y i + , y i − ) (y_{i}^{+},y_{i}^{-}) , but builds them differently from CORE: the frozen parent output is the negative y i − y_{i}^{-} , and a complete candidate is taken as the positive y i + y_{i}^{+} only when it has higher canonical Combined F1 and its Edge F1 is no more than 0.050 0.050 below that of y i − y_{i}^{-} . This conservative rule yields 41 pairs from the 274 training records. DPO increases the preferred response’s log-probability relative to the rejected response and a frozen reference policy [ 9 ] ; scores cover all assistant tokens. Settings are listed above. The fixed diagnostic is excluded from pair construction and model selection. Because DPO and CORE use 41 and 73 comparisons respectively and different learning rates, their comparison does not isolate objective choice alone.
paragraphs.zh: 经过验证的偏好学习分支使用模型生成的候选级配对，但优化的是直接偏好优化（DPO）[9]。 它同样在正负配对 ( y i + , y i − ) (y_{i}^{+},y_{i}^{-}) 上训练，但构建方式与 CORE 不同：冻结的父级输出作为负样本 y i − y_{i}^{-}，而一个完整候选只有在规范化的 Combined F1 更高且其 Edge F1 比 y i − y_{i}^{-} 低不超过 0.050 0.050 时，才被取为正样本 y i + y_{i}^{+}。 这条保守规则从 274 条训练记录中得到了 41 个配对。 DPO 相对于被拒绝的响应和一个冻结的参考策略来提升被偏好响应的对数概率 [9]；分数覆盖所有智能体（assistant）标记。 各项设置如上文所列。 固定诊断项不参与配对构建和模型选择。 由于 DPO 和 CORE 分别使用 41 次和 73 次比较以及不同的学习率，二者的比较无法单独分离出目标函数选择的因素。

The 0.097 Combined gap between sequence ranking and the gold-selected oracle locates substantial unrealised information in the candidate bank. paragraphs.en: We presented a two-stage generate-then-rank approach to goal interpretation for embodied agents: supervised fine-tuning for goal generation, followed by learning to rank candidate outputs with CORE. On the fixed diagnostic, CORE improves Combined and Edge F1 over greedy SFT and the implemented DPO comparator, while DPO retains higher Action F1. The candidate analysis identifies useful goals that generation already supplies but selection misses.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种面向具身智能体目标解释的两阶段“先生成后排序”方法：先进行有监督微调以生成目标，再用 CORE 学习对候选输出进行排序。 在固定的诊断集上，CORE 在 Combined F1 和 Edge F1 上优于贪心 SFT 以及所实现的 DPO 对比方法，而 DPO 则保持了更高的 Action F1。 候选分析表明，生成阶段已经提供了有用目标，但选择阶段未能将其选出。

paragraphs.en: The evidence is limited to one adaptation seed and a repeatedly inspected 68-item diagnostic covering five task families. CORE and DPO also differ in pair construction and optimisation settings, and CORE inference reuses a bank generated by an earlier ranking-trained checkpoint. These comparisons do not establish an isolated causal effect of the CORE loss. The anchor and Edge utility weights lack sensitivity ablations, and serialisation robustness is untested.
paragraphs.zh: 证据仅限于一个适配种子和一份经过反复检查、涵盖五个任务族的68题诊断集。 CORE 与 DPO 在配对构建和优化设置上也存在差异，且 CORE 推理复用了由早期排名训练检查点生成的题库。 这些比较并不能确立 CORE 损失的独立因果效应。 锚点与 Edge 效用权重缺乏敏感性消融实验，且序列化鲁棒性未经测试。

paragraphs.en: The immediate experimental priority is a matched extra-SFT versus CORE continuation from the same parent, holding data, update budget, learning rate, and candidate bank fixed, followed by anchor/Edge-weight ablations. Multiple training seeds can retain the exact task-disjoint 274/68 split; no diagnostic items need enter training. Such runs measure optimisation variability, while fresh held-out families are needed to assess generalisation beyond this repeatedly inspected diagnostic. Listwise ranking and matched constrained decoding remain untested alternatives. Downstream planning success and semantic repair require separate evaluation: symbolic F1 alone cannot establish executability.
paragraphs.zh: 当前的实验优先事项是从同一父模型出发，进行匹配的额外SFT与CORE继续训练的对比，保持数据、更新预算、学习率和候选库固定，随后进行锚点/Edge权重消融实验。 多个训练种子可以保留完全相同的任务不相交274/68划分；无需将任何诊断项加入训练。 这类运行衡量的是优化层面的变异性，而要评估超越这个被反复检查的诊断集的泛化能力，则需要全新的留出族。 列表级排序和匹配的约束解码仍是未经测试的替代方案。 下游规划成功率和语义修复需要单独评估：仅凭符号F1无法确立可执行性。
